stories.what_happened: The Ministry of Finance confirmed the transition on 2 November. The consortium facilitates financial cooperation and investment among SCO members.
stories.background: The SCO's financial cooperation forum is distinct from its political and security organs.

stories.headline: Finance minister discusses Eurobond tokenisation and digital-asset safeguards

stories.what_happened: He addressed a Pakistan Banks' Association dialogue and said cabinet approval would precede a request for bids on the proposal.
stories.background: Tokenisation uses digital records to represent financial claims; a review is not an executed transaction.
stories.why_it_matters: The proposal raises questions of investor protection, sovereign-debt management and cybersecurity.

stories.headline: US-linked consortium proposes integrated $4.4 billion LNG scheme

stories.headline: China and Oman call for safe navigation through Hormuz
stories.summary: President Xi Jinping met Oman's Sultan Haitham bin Tariq on 2 November; the two governments issued a 20-point statement supporting safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.what_happened: Reuters reported the first visit by an Omani head of state to China since diplomatic ties began in 1978. The parties also discussed energy cooperation.
stories.background: Oman plays a role in Gulf diplomacy; calls for dialogue are not a negotiated ceasefire.
